best_language.description: A language Gef can use for the short native-language lesson introduction.
required_assets: support-blurbs manifest entry for the requested topic
best_language.notes: All 104 canonical learn-from languages can explain the vocabulary layer.

learning_language_full.description: A language that receives the complete ordered-term lesson, rich language-specific systems, cultural context, and practice.
learning_language_full.registry_requirement: Must be in lesson Tier 1 or Tier 2.
learning_language_full.notes: Full lesson capability is deliberately narrower than vocabulary-game capability.

learning_language_vocab.description: A language that can expose the canonical vocabulary concepts to Lexi and vocabulary games without receiving the rich cultural lesson.
learning_language_vocab.notes: Tier 3 uses the short source-language blurb plus vocabulary/game blocks only. It does not receive cultural_context or alternate-system teaching merely because vocabulary exists.

vocab_learning_language_policy.days_months_source: Unicode CLDR locale names, with explicit checked overrides when the pinned runtime locale data falls back to placeholders

vocab.notes: The localized_text is the short native-language intro. Practice must remain vocabulary/game practice, not rich grammar or cultural-context assessment.
